rationale: Charlie is building Expo as the universal platform for mobile and web apps, with a conviction that AI is expanding who can build software—while Wang has scaled BYD from a 20-person battery startup into the world's largest EV manufacturer through vertical integration and deep technical control. Their paths don't overlap directly, but Wang's experience building manufacturing scale, controlling core technology (batteries, semiconductors), and navigating brutal competitive phases could inform how Expo thinks about platform dominance and staying ahead as AI tooling democratizes app development.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Wang Chuanfu — you've both scaled technical platforms into dominant positions by controlling the core technology layer; his insights on vertical integration and market consolidation could be valuable as you expand Expo's ambitions.
